other_conditions: Must be a disabled ex‑serviceman discharged from the Armed Forces on medical grounds with disability not attributable to service
Must be a bonafide resident of Haryana
Must not be receiving any financial assistance or pension from any source
Must produce a certificate from the District Social Welfare Officer confirming no receipt of financial assistance or pension
Receiving old age pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from any other department will lead to permanent debarment
Payment will be discontinued for persons in civil employment
Survival verification proof must be submitted annually in April
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month, with an annual increase of ₹400.
documents_required: Certificate from District Social Welfare Officer confirming no receipt of financial assistance or pension
